<thought>We need to locate the retrosynthetic template that breaks an aliphatic hydroxyl (functional group “aliphatic hydroxyls”) and forms an alkyl halide (functional group “alkyl halide”). Using these functional‑group criteria should retrieve the correct template. Once we have the template ID we can fetch its mapped reaction SMILES and return it.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC=O)c1FC1CN(Cc2ccc(Cn3nnc(Cl)c3Cl)cc2)C1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkyl halide"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
